summary.text: Adam Duda is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Ellen Schutt.

paragraphs.text: Adam Duda earned bachelor's and graduate degrees from Stevens Institute of Technology and a law degree from Rutgers Law School, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as self-employed.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his parents brought him to America at age nine, and that his work has included service as a patent examiner at the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office and as a law clerk in Washington, D.C.
Duda defeated Steven Doelder in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 11 on August 11, 2026, receiving 58.5% of the vote.

In the survey, he said he supports increasing shared revenue and expanding the Homestead Tax Credit, strict water and environmental standards for data centers, nonpartisan redistricting, and protecting access to IVF and contraception.
